name: RBB Bancorp
summary: RBB Bancorp operates as the bank holding company for Royal Business Bank that provides business-banking and consumer products and services to Asian-centric communities in the United States. The company offers deposit products, including checking, savings, money market, and time deposits; retail deposits; brokered deposits, collateralized deposits, and deposits acquired through internet listing services; and certificates of deposit. It also provides lending products, such as single-family residential, commercial real estate, construction and land development, commercial and industrial, and small business administration loans.
